mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS (negative change implies positive returns).
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI index above 215.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 215.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500.0 thousand units and the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a contraction in the housing market coupled with tight monetary policy, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: housing market contraction and monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods where HOUST < 500.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (i.e., UNRATE falling) signals improving labor market conditions, which reduces recession risk and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 8.0% and UNRATE declines, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals a contraction in the real economy, increasing the risk of recession and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the 3-month change in INDPRO (negative change implies negative returns).
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods where INDPRO declines over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods where HOUST < 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market growth (PAYEMS 3-month change) falls below 0.5% and the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a weak labor market coupled with tight monetary policy, increasing the risk of recession and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: weak labor market and monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods where PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI index above 215.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 215.0.
